description: Execute the stored flow session in mock or live mode as a task-backed run. Requires MCP task augmentation; clients without it should call start_asset_flow_run and poll get_asset_flow_task instead.

idempotencyKey.description: Dedupe key so retries do not launch duplicate runs; reuse the same key to re-attach to the first dispatch.

mode.description: mock = free dry run. live = paid provider generation — confirm with the user first.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

targetNodeId.description: Run only the subgraph feeding this node. A root run defaults to the backend's first generate target, so a multi-branch graph generates one image per run unless a branch is named here. Ignored for asset-set flows, whose target is the plan's downstream generate node.

name: run_asset_flow
